test.description: Run saved checks through actual CLI, MCP and local HTTP adapters; attack request boundaries and render the evidence panel.

source.name: Independent boundary regressions; the command also runs transport and rendered UI tests.

test.inputs: Temporary repositories, successful and failing commands, stale identities, duplicate requests, overlapping runs, large output and escaped artifact paths.
test.expected: Only the saved command runs in its checkout. Repeated requests reuse a run. Output is bounded and integrity checked. Stale evidence cannot pass; unrelated results survive. UI keeps authored expectations separate from actual logs.
